    out=[r[:] for r in grid]

    twos=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    # project each contiguous pair of 2s inward along its orientation
    for r,c in twos:

                out[rr][c]=5
        elif r+1<h and grid[r+1][c]==2:
            for cc in range(c+1,w):
                if grid[r][cc]==2: break
                out[r][cc]=5
    for r in range(h):

    return out
')
